subject: general
question: Which two major initiatives in the agriculture sector were launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi during the special Krishi programme in New Delhi in October 2025?

options.text: PM Kisan Samman Yojana and National Soil Health Mission
PM Dhan Dhaanya Krishi Yojana and Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana and National Fertilizer Scheme
Crop Diversification Initiative and Sustainable Farming Programme

solution:
The correct answer is __**PM Dhan Dhaanya Krishi Yojana and Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched two major initiatives in the agriculture sector: PM Dhan Dhaanya Krishi Yojana and Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM Dhan Dhaanya Krishi Yojana, with an outlay of ₹24,000 crore, aims to enhance agricultural productivity, crop diversification, and improve irrigation facilities in selected 100 districts.**
 
• **Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses, with ₹11,440 crore, focuses on improving pulse productivity, expanding cultivation, and strengthening the value chain for pulses.**
 
• **Prime Minister Modi highlighted the importance of transforming the fortunes of farmers and emphasized agricultural reforms initiated since 2014.**
 
• **The government also inaugurated projects in agriculture, animal husbandry, fisheries, and food processing sectors, while laying the foundation for more projects.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• PM Dhan Dhaanya Krishi Yojana__

 __
 
• Launched to enhance agricultural productivity, improve crop diversification, and facilitate long-term credit for farmers in 100 low-performing agricultural districts.
 
 
 
• Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses__
 __
 
• Focuses on expanding pulse cultivation, improving productivity, and strengthening the pulse value chain including procurement, storage, and processing.
 
 
 
• Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi__
 __
 
• Government initiative transferring direct benefits to farmers, ensuring financial support for eligible farmers.
 
 
 
• Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)__
 
 
• Over ₹3.90 lakh crore has been transferred to farmers' bank accounts through DBT, helping strengthen the financial ecosystem in agriculture.
 
 

57:T
